items.source: Will register all of the supplied scopes with the ConfigurableListableBeanFactory that is passed to the postProcessBeanFactory(ConfigurableListableBeanFactory) method.
items.translation: 将提供的所有 scopes 注册到传递给 postProcessBeanFactory(ConfigurableListableBeanFactory) 方法的 ConfigurableListableBeanFactory 中。

items.source: This class allows for declarative registration of custom scopes. Alternatively, consider implementing a custom BeanFactoryPostProcessor that calls ConfigurableBeanFactory.registerScope(String, Scope) programmatically.
items.translation: 该类允许以声明式方式注册自定义作用域。或者，可以考虑实现一个自定义的BeanFactoryPostProcessor，该处理器会调用ConfigurableBeanFactory.registerScope(String, Scope)以编程方式注册。

items.source: The keys indicate the scope names (of type String); each value is expected to be the corresponding custom Scope instance or class name.
items.translation: 键指示作用域名称（类型为 String）；每个值预期为相应的自定义Scope实例或类名。

items.source: Add the given scope to this configurer's map of scopes.
items.translation: 将此范围添加到该配置器的范围映射中。

items.source: scope - the scope implementation
items.translation: scope - 作用域实现

items.source: Juergen Hoeller, Rick Evans
items.translation: Juergen Hoeller, Rick Evans

items.source: Invoked after the population of normal bean properties but before an initialization callback such as InitializingBean's InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet() method or a custom init-method.
items.translation: 在普通 Bean 属性填充后之后、但在初始化回调（例如 InitializingBean's InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet() 方法）或自定义 init-method 之前之前调用。

items.source: Higher values are interpreted as lower priority. As a consequence, the object with the lowest value has the highest priority (somewhat analogous to Servlet load-on-startup values).
items.translation: 较高的值被解释为较低的优先级。因此，具有最低值的对象具有最高的优先级（类似于 Servlet 的 `load-on-startup` 值）。

items.source:
Same order values will result in arbitrary sort positions for the
affected objects.
items.translation: 相同的顺序值将导致受影响的对象具有任意的排序位置。

items.source: Specify the custom scopes that are to be registered.
items.translation: 指定要注册的自定义范围。

items.source:
Modify the application context's internal bean factory after its standard
initialization. All bean definitions will have been loaded, but no beans
will have been instantiated yet. This allows for overriding or adding
properties even to eager-initializing beans.
items.translation: 在标准初始化之后修改应用程序上下文内部的 Bean 工厂。此时所有 Bean 定义都已被加载，但尚未实例化任何 Bean。这允许您甚至对急切初始化的 Bean 进行属性覆盖或添加。
